ambiguities: It is unclear whether 'elle est extraordinaire, Mme Poncin !' addresses Mme Poncin vocatively while praising 'la femme du Premier' for her dramatic gossip-mongering, or instead applies 'extraordinaire' to Mme Poncin herself; the former reading is more natural given 'elle' most plausibly refers to the immediately preceding subject, and it targets a non-candidate character, so no event on a candidate was scored. Princesse de Luxembourg appears only as a temporal marker for the scene ('le soir de la visite de...') with no evaluative content directed at her.
